inputs.label: Silent Hill (USA) disc
inputs.help: The .bin and .cue of your own Silent Hill disc, USA version (SLUS-00707), named exactly Silent Hill (USA).bin and Silent Hill (USA).cue. Unzip them first.

steps.why: The game cannot read the disc without All files access, which the guide has the user allow on the first launch.

steps.text: Open Silent Hill VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for All files access, allow it, then start the game again. Saves and logs stay in SilentHillVR after an uninstall.

otherWays.label: Install-SilentHillVR.bat
otherWays.help: A Windows script in the release. Over USB it installs the APK, grants storage access and copies your disc files, fetching adb from Google if needed.

notes: Quest 3; v0.1 is a pre-release and the only release, hence prerelease: true. The release also holds SilentHillVR-Quest-0.1-source.zip, which the asset pattern avoids. The optional HD texture pack (zipped, in gamedata/texturemods/) and HD maps (in gamedata/load/) are left out: steps cannot be optional per file, and their links are only in the project's README. The appop grant mirrors what the release's .bat does; untested on a headset.
